name: @paperos/spike-kit
description: PAP-753: shared spike harness. Standalone — not part of the pnpm workspace or turbo build (spikes/** matches no glob in root pnpm-workspace.yaml). A candidate spike scaffolded by `node scripts/spike-new.mjs` from the repo root runs this kit's scripts via `tsx ../_kit/src/*.ts`, so the harness (Vite/Playwright/Zod versions and the measuring code) lives in exactly one place.
